_comment: Best-effort real-world magnitude anchors for common/recurring health-condition generalization tiers, used by src/cloak/lattice_producer/coherence.py to keep per-level counts internally consistent across a run. Not certifying counts (Fix Area 2's DOID loader in reference_sources.py supplies real, certifying chains where a DOID match exists); this is a fallback anchor for the ceiling tiers above DOID's own root and for entries with no DOID match. Promoted from scripts/spikes/clean_drug_health_lattice_coherence.py.

_sources._semantics: Counts are RUNTIME-TYPE-CONDITIONAL anonymity-set sizes: the number of distinct health-condition entities in the tier, matching the producer prompt's count_semantics_instruction -- NOT the tier's ontology-universe size. The previous 500,000 'medical condition' value did not even match its own cited source and inflated the root rung.
_sources.medical condition: ICD-10-CM FY2026: 74,719 billable diagnosis codes (icd10data.com/CMS); the practical broadest catch-all bucket, larger than any subordinate anchor by design
_sources.clinical finding: conditional estimate: distinct commonly-named findings that appear as condition-type entities; kept below the 'medical condition' catch-all to preserve the corpus tier order
_sources.genetic disorder: OMIM: similar order to Orphanet's rare-disease count
_sources.other entries: rough counts of distinct commonly-named conditions in that organ-system/diagnostic class, not a specific registry lookup
